text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several comments mention salads lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and one dish was described as bland. There were also concerns about portion size and pricing, with at least one visitor noting the lack of water cups. Service was mentioned once, suggesting some dissatisfaction. Overall, the average rating was low, reflecting these recurring problems.
